Average puzzle gameplay. The gyroscope simulation is accurate, but some levels feel repetitive despite having 250 stages on the map. It is alright.
Decent 3D physics puzzle. The linear campaign map is nice, but I find myself running out of rotational momentum just inches away from victory.
Sleek 3D presentation and no intrusive pop-ups while playing. Adjusting the launch angle and torque requires actual thinking, which is refreshing.
